"App: Diet Diary; Google Play listing title in Russian: «Дневник диеты: подсчёт калорий»; package: ru.dietdiary.offline.\nProject developer: Efreitor2001. For questions about the app and data processing, contact https://github.com/Efreitor2001/kkalcal/issues . GitHub issues are public: do not post health records, backups, passwords or tokens there."

"1. Diary on your device\nNo registration is required to keep a diary. The app stores foods and their nutritional values, portions and meal dates, weight, waist measurements, body fat percentage, steps, sleep, workout descriptions, notes, goals, achievements and app settings in its private storage area on your device. Optional fields may be left blank. Steps, sleep and measurements are entered manually; the app does not read Health Connect, physical activity sensors or medical device data."

"This information is used to calculate calories and macronutrients and to provide history, charts and achievements. The developer does not operate a server that receives diary contents. If you do not connect Google Drive or share a backup yourself, your records remain on your device."

"2. Optional Google Drive connection\nAt your request, the app opens Google sign-in in your default browser and requests access to this app’s hidden data storage in your Google Drive. This permission does not provide access to your ordinary Drive documents or photos."

"Once connected, foods, meals, diary measurements, notes, goals, achievements, transferable settings and change metadata, including random installation identifiers and timestamps, are sent to Google. This supports backup snapshots and merging entries across your devices. If automatic sync is enabled, changes are also sent in the background when a network connection is available. You can turn off automatic sync separately."

"The app receives the email address and identifier of the selected Google account to show the connection and link it to the correct storage. Your Google password is not provided to the app. The authorisation session is stored encrypted on your device using a key in Android Keystore. Tokens, email addresses and Google identifiers are excluded from diary exports and synchronised JSON snapshots."
"Google data is used only for authorisation and sync, never for advertising. Google’s privacy policy applies: https://policies.google.com/privacy ."

"3. Backup files\n“Save to file” creates a JSON file in the location you choose. Restore reads only the file you select. If you select a cloud file provider or share a copy with another person, you choose the recipient. The app does not encrypt exported JSON files: these files contain personal records and change metadata."

"4. Advertising\nThe app uses the Yandex Mobile Ads SDK. To load and display ads, your device connects to advertising services. Yandex may process your IP address and other technical information about the network request, device and software, available advertising or technical identifiers, and information about ad impressions and interactions."

"The app tells the SDK that consent has not been given, disables location collection and disables App Ad Analytics reporting. It does not request precise or approximate location permissions. These settings do not mean that the advertising service performs no network communication or technical data processing."

"The app does not use food records, weight, measurements, notes, goals, email addresses or Google identifiers for ad targeting, and does not add them to ad request parameters. Viewing ads is not required to save entries."

"Yandex’s rules for data processing, retention and deletion: https://yandex.ru/legal/confidential/ . You can manage your advertising identifier in Android settings if your system version supports this feature. The advertising service’s policy determines retention periods for its technical data; the diary developer does not set a separate retention period for that data."

"5. Data protection\nCommunication with Google uses HTTPS; Yandex states that SDK data is transmitted using HTTPS/TLS. The local diary is protected by Android’s app isolation. The app does not separately encrypt diary contents or JSON snapshots; it does not provide end-to-end encryption between devices."

"System backup of app data is disabled. Diagnostic logs written by the app’s own code contain result codes without diary contents, email addresses, tokens or network response bodies; the app does not separately send these logs to the developer."

"6. Retention and deletion\nLocal records remain until you change or delete them, or clear the app’s data. Deleting an entry removes it from the interface and sends a deletion marker during sync. Merge metadata is retained to prevent old data from reappearing; it may contain previous values from a deleted diary entry. Previous values may also remain in old cloud snapshots and files you created earlier. Deleting one entry therefore does not completely erase every copy of it."
"“Disconnect account” stops sync on this device and deletes the local Google session. The diary and snapshots in Google Drive are kept. Disconnecting the app does not delete your Google account."

"To completely delete this app’s data:
• Turn off sync on all your devices so that remaining copies are not uploaded again.
• In a browser, open https://drive.google.com/drive/settings using the Google account that was connected. Select “Manage apps”, find “Diet Diary” (or «Дневник диеты»), then choose “Options” → “Delete hidden app data”. If the mobile page does not show this section, use the desktop version of the site or a computer.
• Revoke the app’s access at https://myaccount.google.com/connections . Revoking access alone does not erase saved copies.
• Clear the app’s storage in Android settings on each device, or uninstall the app.
• Delete separately saved JSON backups from the folders and cloud storage locations you chose."

"Without your credentials, the developer cannot remotely erase your local diary or files in your personal Google Drive. Do not share your password or tokens with the developer. For help with deletion, contact the project using the link at the start of this policy. You do not need to delete your Google account to delete diary data."

"7. Changes and contact\nWhen app features or data processing practices change, this policy is updated with a revision date. For questions about access, correction, deletion of data or the app’s operation, use the project’s contact channel. Requests you submit are processed to provide a response and are stored in GitHub; GitHub’s policy is available at https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement ."
